notes.title: AstroMole demo update
notes.notes:
Hello Brave Travellers!

The AstroMole demo just got better! A new level has been added, Prehistoric Sands!

There are even more Treasures to find in these Dino filled Planets, as well as plenty of enemies and allies!

Butt heads with these guys:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/05b2a8c377c5b78f23263c261169dada03a97bcd.gif

Escape the pursuit of these mean Dinos:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/aae701bedce0fb8331c99e93f1feb10d78d9827b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/f1fc5c5a9b04f3ec0bef2f010f7b4bc17b36d6a1.gif

Watch out for the Steggy's plates too:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/7cd1a3982517c24cf7d475081f0a5ccce5933c2a.gif

It's not just the Dinos that you'll have to look out for. The environment is dangerous too!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/8de2b86029f954f32039104ff3af60bd5527ea24.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/0202e2f602acd676fcfe94f5c92eea65003a5ce4.gif

Luckily, there are some friendly Dinos that have evolved brains. They'll be happy to help as long as their social status remains intact!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44910185/35ed38d0348c3d6ec20182c428f22d2451038171.png

Hope you enjoy the demo so far!

notes.title: Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hello Brave Travellers!

Just a quick update to say that work is progressing smoothly on the demo! The timeline has changed too so here's a summary of what expect over the next few months:


 June 2024 - First demo release: the demo will contain one level that has one biome, with plenty of treasures to find and a variety of enemies to beat.
 July-August 2024 - Final demo release: This demo will contain two levels with a biome each with even more treasure and enemies!
 September 2024 - Full game release

Look forward to more updates in the future! Follow my socials to stay updated HERE
